description:
Configure a custom Apache Log Format to track request latency. 

1. In the Global Apache Configuration (Webmin > Servers > Apache Webserver > Global Configuration > Configure Apache Modules > log_config is usually enabled by default, go to Log Files or edit Config Files directly if needed), define a new Log Format with the nickname 'latency_trace'. 
2. The format string must be the standard Combined format appended with the execution time in microseconds (%D). The format string should look like: "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b \"%{Referer}i\" \"%{User-Agent}i\" %D"
3. Apply this 'latency_trace' format to the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server's access log configuration. 
4. Ensure the changes are applied (restart/reload Apache).
